subject.title: fix(codex): heartbeat notifications to other channels are silently denied by cross-context policy

question: Should #102232 be the landing vehicle for #102206, or should maintainers replace it with the broader #102217 diagnostics branch?
rationale: Both PRs target the same P1 message-loss regression, but #102232 is the narrow proof-sufficient resolver fix while #102217 adds operator-visible diagnostics and script scope that need owner acceptance and repair/proof review.

options.title: Land #102232 as the narrow fix
options.body: Use this PR for the release repair because it preserves WebChat containment, covers the source-reported webchat/webchat shape, and avoids new public SDK or diagnostics surface.

options.title: Promote #102217 after repair
options.body: Choose the broader branch only if maintainers want the diagnostic event in the same change and require its lint/proof gaps to be resolved first.

options.title: Split diagnostics follow-up
options.body: Land #102232, close or supersede the overlapping PRs, and open a separate owner-reviewed diagnostics follow-up if observability remains desired.

recommendation.title: Land #102232 as the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Use this PR for the release repair because it preserves WebChat containment, covers the source-reported webchat/webchat shape, and avoids new public SDK or diagnostics surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is about the outbound cross-context guard invariant and whether diagnostics should be added around that policy surface.
